player_prompt.intro:
Ozali kobeta na Tower of Hanoi na {num_disks} disks.
Ozali kobenga disks kati ya tower A na tower C.
Koteka disk, andika tower ya kati na tower ya kombo (kwa mfano, '[A C]').
Lingala ezali kwamba ozali kobenga disk ya liboso ya tower, na kwamba disk ya kiboko ezali weka kati ya disk ya liboso.
Kwa kila mukolo, tondisa kimia kimia.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ozali kosalela na '[source] [target]' ezali na ndakisa.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Opesi esika ya kowuta to ndako molai oyo ebongi te.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Olingaki kolongola disque moko na ndako ya molai oyo ezalaki lisusu na eloko te.
invalid_move.same_tower: Omekaki komema disque na ndako yango.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Olingaki kotya diske moko ya monene likoló na mosusu oyo ezalaki moke.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You solved the Tower of Hanoi puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: Bozwi ndelo ya kobongwana. Otii malamu {pct}% na ba disques likolo ya tour C.
